name: Red Lobster Plain Baked Potato Side (Flesh Only)
whyItWorks: Fluffy baked russet potato served dry. Discarding the outer skin leaves a soft, easily absorbed soluble starch cushion for your fish entree.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Baked potato, 100% dry—NO butter, NO sour cream, NO bacon bits.' Season the interior flesh with salt.
